records.description: How the configuration defines the container image or service: a prebuilt image reference, a Dockerfile build, or a Compose project.
The state of the target container when the operation begins: absent, stopped, running, or running against a configuration that has since changed.
The Feature composition the scenario exercises, including how install order is decided.
How the effective configuration is assembled: a single document, an extends chain, a command-line overlay, or a layer derived from image metadata.
The consumer operation under test. This dimension partitions the combination space; it is never itself a pair member.
Whether the operation's result is observed as a structured document or as human-readable output.
